title: Formal complaint frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 43 (Pupil PDF worksheet: formal complaint frame)
intro: Lesson 43: Writing a complaint about accommodation. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
السَّيِّدُ المُدِيرُ المُحْتَرَمُ،
نَزَلْتُ فِي فُنْدُقِكُمْ مِنْ ٣ إِلَى ٦ إِبْرِيل. أَوَّلًا، كَانَتِ الغُرْفَةُ غَيْرَ نَظِيفَةٍ. ثَانِيًا، لَمْ يَعْمَلِ المُكَيِّفُ.
أَطْلُبُ أَنْ تُعِيدُوا لِي جُزْءًا مِنَ المَالِ.
مَعَ التَّحِيَّةِ، يُوسُف

parts.label: Teacher
parts.text: أَطْلُبُ + أَنْ + subjunctive plural تُغَيِّرُوا (no نَ) + الغُرْفَةَ.

questions.q: Write the request: I request that you change the room.
Write a formal complaint (our own exam-style task, 100 words) in the portal response box: two problems, one request, formal opening and closing.
questions.a: Formal register; two problems; correct أَنْ and لَمْ forms

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer

questions.q: Correct the verb: أَطْلُبُ أَنْ ___ المُشْكِلَةَ (you all solve)
questions.a: A) تَحُلُّوا. After أَنْ the subjunctive drops the نَ: تَحُلُّوا.
Clear facts, specific request, no insults.
